source_resolution: git show <upstream_revision>:<path>; hashes describe original source files, not production output

adaptations.description: Original wxGetApp access is replaced with actual PresetBundle/Model/plate DynamicPrintConfig references; window refresh, text writes, persisted GUI selection and background scheduling are omitted.

Only fully loaded non-cut FFF object trees: multi-volume objects have volume nodes; a single volume aliases the object only without instance/layer subtrees. Missing required layer extruder is rejected before the delete data statements. Cut/connector trees are not claimed supported.
wxColour RGBA bytes are adapted through existing ColorRGBA/decode_color and passed to the same FlushVolCalculator. Invalid colour is rejected, not replaced by a default.
GUI_App::is_support_filament is called with its default strict_check=true by automatic flushing. Its strict path is extracted; optional PLA/PETG heuristics are not reached.

An optional source filament selects the target physical tool's existing preset; an explicit preset may override that selection. Ordinary Orca append still copies the last preset. Overrides are resolved before new flushing entries are computed.
Plate sequence decoding assertions are checked before executing the native decoder; no invalid ranges, layer values or material references are silently filled.

compatibility_observations: ObjectList writes a decremented volume support setting into object config while retaining the volume value; this asymmetry is intentionally preserved.
Plater replacement branch retains remove_if's tail and overwrites only the first tail extruder; native tests deliberately record that behavior rather than inventing a clean merge.

Current committed ModelVolume stale-extruder cleanup and PresetBundle matrix fixes are retained. This is a pinned GUI extraction using current native primitives, not a claim that all production files equal the old upstream commit.
verification_limit: Original-file hashes identify provenance only. No hash of newly written implementation is offered as proof of equivalence; native reference cases, protocol cases and actual slicing are separate validation obligations.
source_role: Orca GUI revision retained in this library repository Git history

approved_native_fix.reason: Initialize the cache identity before its first comparison. An isolated initialization experiment eliminated cold/repeated export differences; the original retraction rules are unchanged.
